what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Hawk Dash
summary: R123's Hawk Dash: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the Falcon XR8 Sprint. Long bonnet with a power bulge and two vents, a gaping hexagonal grille under swept narrow lamps, vertical lamp slots in the bumper corners, wide wrap-around tail lamps, quad exhausts, a ducktail lip, twin stripes nose to tail and a side 'C' stripe. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Lion President's spec twin.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

reference.note: The reference sheets were generated with Muse Image from a written brief (art/vehicles/hawk-dash/refs/prompts/), the Cruz Missile's sheet given as the layout example. Per view: the reference crop, the model shaded, and the silhouette diff (green is model only, red is reference only). Scored by tools/vehicles/fit (Spike J's method: perspective camera, the same mask pipeline on both sides, the contact-shadow band left out).

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the back detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line (tools/vehicles/evidence).

paints.pattern: Seat colour on the paint key (white texels tint; the black stripes, glass, lamps and tyres keep their colour), the number on the roof between the stripes (anchor roof_number) and in the HUD badge. paints-strip.png shows white plus five player colours. Known defect br-vhtm: filtered stripe edges are untinted grey, so at grid size the stripes read light grey.
